notes.zh-CN: 优化应用内更新：可自动检查与下载，更新说明更易读，窗口外观与设置一致。
notes.en-US: Smoother in-app updates: auto check and download, clearer release notes, dialog matches Settings.

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 启动后可自动检查更新，并在后台下载
下载完成后可自动安装并重新打开 WePic
设置 → 关于 可随时查看更新记录

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 更新窗口外观与设置界面一致
更新说明改成更通俗的表述，方便了解改了什么

en-US.title: Features
items: Auto-check for updates after launch, with background download
When ready, install and reopen WePic automatically
Open update history anytime from Settings → About

en-US.title: Improvements
items: Update window looks consistent with Settings
Release notes rewritten in plain language

zh-CN.title: 功能
items: 支持在应用内检查并安装新版本
改进联网稳定性，在线功能与更新更可靠

zh-CN.title: 改进
items: 关于页可查看更新内容
遇到有问题的版本时可选择跳过

en-US.title: Features
items: Check and install updates from inside the app
More reliable online features and update downloads

en-US.title: Improvements
items: Skip a release you do not want to install
